Definition: of Hebrew origin (H6939); Cedron (i.e. Kidron), a brook near Jerusalem:--Cedron.
BiblicalUsage: Cedron, the Kidron, is the brook between Jerusalem and the Mount of Olives. John 18:1 says Jesus went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the brook is the last water before the garden: Jesus crossed it knowing what waited on the other side.
